pages.text: BOSS essences are unique items obtained by killing BOSS mobs with a Bio Crusher.$(br2)$(bold)Essence Types$()$(br2)$(bold)Wither Essence$()$(br2)Has a 5% base chance to drop when a Wither is killed by a Bio Crusher. Looting Upgrades can increase the amount after a successful roll, but do not increase the 5% trigger chance.

$(bold)Ender Dragon Essence$()$(br2)Has a 10% base chance to drop when an Ender Dragon is killed by a Bio Crusher. Looting Upgrades can increase the amount after a successful roll, but do not increase the 10% trigger chance.
$(bold)Elder Guardian Essence$()$(br2)Obtained when a Bio Crusher kills an Elder Guardian. Looting Upgrades may increase the essence amount.

$(bold)Acquisition$()$(br2)To obtain BOSS essences:$(br2)1. Build a Bio Crusher (Advanced or Extended)$(br)2. Place it near a BOSS mob$(br)3. The Bio Crusher will kill the BOSS and generate the corresponding essence$(br2)Note: The Bio Crusher must be powerful enough to kill BOSS mobs. It is recommended to use the Sharpness Upgrade to increase damage.$(br2)$(bold)Crafting Uses$()$(br2)BOSS essences can be used to craft advanced items and machines, serving as important late-game materials.

$(li)Wither Essence: Infuse with 64,000 mB of Life Fluid and 100,000 FE to create a Wither Spawn Egg$(li)Ender Dragon Essence: Infuse with 64,000 mB of Life Fluid and 100,000 FE to create an Ender Dragon Spawn Egg$(li)Elder Guardian Essence: Infuse with 64,000 mB of Life Fluid and 100,000 FE to create an Elder Guardian Spawn Egg
